mapper.select: SELECT item_id AS itemId, name, gold_cost AS goldCost, icon_url AS iconUrl, stats_modifier::text AS statsModifierJson, skill_refs::text AS skillRefsJson, recipe_ids::text AS recipeIdsJson FROM public.items WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY item_id

SELECT item_id AS itemId, name, gold_cost AS goldCost, icon_url AS iconUrl, stats_modifier::text AS statsModifierJson, skill_refs::text AS skillRefsJson, recipe_ids::text AS recipeIdsJson FROM public.items WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND item_id = #{itemId}

SELECT item_id AS itemId, name, gold_cost AS goldCost, icon_url AS iconUrl, stats_modifier::text AS statsModifierJson, skill_refs::text AS skillRefsJson, recipe_ids::text AS recipeIdsJson FROM public.items WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND updated_at > #{updatedAfter} ORDER BY item_id
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.items (game_id, item_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, name, gold_cost, icon_url, stats_modifier, skill_refs, recipe_ids, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{itemId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{name}, #{goldCost}, #{iconUrl}, CAST(#{statsModifierJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{skillRefsJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{recipeIdsJson} AS jsonb), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, item_id) DO UPDATE SET start_version_id = EXCLUDED.start_version_id, end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, name = EXCLUDED.name, gold_cost = EXCLUDED.gold_cost, icon_url = EXCLUDED.icon_url, stats_modifier = EXCLUDED.stats_modifier, skill_refs = EXCLUDED.skill_refs, recipe_ids = EXCLUDED.recipe_ids, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO public.items_log (game_id, item_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, name, gold_cost, icon_url, stats_modifier, skill_refs, recipe_ids) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{itemId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{name}, #{goldCost}, #{iconUrl}, CAST(#{statsModifierJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{skillRefsJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{recipeIdsJson} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (game_id, item_id, start_version_id) DO UPDATE SET end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, name = EXCLUDED.name, gold_cost = EXCLUDED.gold_cost, icon_url = EXCLUDED.icon_url, stats_modifier = EXCLUDED.stats_modifier, skill_refs = EXCLUDED.skill_refs, recipe_ids = EXCLUDED.recipe_ids
